candidates.change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from the Put function declaration.
Delete the require condition for unlock time so Collect can proceed even if block.timestamp <= acc.unlockTime
Delete the require that acc.balance >= MinSum so Collect does not need a minimum balance threshold
Change require on acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am, preventing withdrawal of exact balance amount
Delete the balance subtraction after a successful send so collector keeps the balance but still receives funds
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage after successful withdrawal so event logging is skipped but balance still decreases
Remove the nonReentrant modifier entirely so reentrant calls can drain more than intended
Replace require(!locked_) with require(locked_) so the guard never allows entry (function always reverts)
Delete the line that resets locked_ to false, making every call after the first revert
